title: NASA's New Telescope: Unveiling Cosmic Secrets!

scenes.text: A groundbreaking telescope launched to uncover the universe!
NASA's Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope can survey 100 times more area than Hubble.
It will help us understand dark energy and the accelerating universe.
This telescope could rewrite our understanding of cosmic expansion!
Follow if curiosity runs your brain.

description: The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope is set to revolutionize our grasp of the cosmos. Follow for daily science!
